items.title: 《價值型投資 最新產業研究報告》聯鈞 (3450-TW) 光通訊出貨增溫，雷射封裝迎接擴產商機
items.title_en: Value Investing Latest Industry Research Report: Lianjun (3450‑TW) Optical‑Communication Shipments Warm Up, Laser Packaging Welcomes Expansion Opportunities
paras: 黃仁勳在柏林GTC談供應鏈擴產，光通訊又成了市場焦點。輝達的CPO交換器先前已宣布進入生產，這次進一步推動光學引擎擴產，代表資料中心的高速連線開始需要更多實際產能。聯鈞 (3450-TW)做雷射晶片封裝，也參與光通訊產品生產，這波變化和它後面的生意有什麼關係，值得研究清楚。
先用一句話理解CPO：把負責收發光訊號的元件，放到更靠近交換器晶片的位置。人工智慧伺服器之間得不停交換資料，距離拉長、速度提高，傳統電訊號的耗電與傳輸損耗就更難處理。改用光來傳資料，有助於降低這段負擔。光學引擎可以想成把電訊號與光訊號互相轉換的小型組件，交換器擴大採用，相關零組件和封裝需求也會跟著增加。

聯鈞 (3450-TW)的專長在雷射封裝。雷射晶片要固定、接線，再經過測試，才能成為客戶能使用的光源元件。功率和傳輸速度提高後，散熱與封裝精度都更重要，長期累積的製程經驗就有用武之地。研究資料顯示，公司產品布局涵蓋供光模組使用的雷射封裝，以及共同封裝光學所需的外接光源，具備參與這波升級的基礎。公司透過光模組客戶參與供應鏈，相關資料提到的客戶包括美國光通訊廠Coherent。產業擴產有助於打開需求，但目前仍應和已確認的個別訂單分開看。
營運已有成長可以對照。聯鈞 (3450-TW)的9月營收約12.89億元，比去年同期接近翻倍。最新研究資料指出，光通訊部門出貨持續增加，雷射封裝需求也在升溫。這個數字包含集團其他業務，不能全部算成CPO收入；目前較明確的動能，仍是既有光通訊客戶拉貨與產品出貨增加。
集團也透過源傑科技發展主動式光纖纜線。白話說，就是把光電轉換元件整合在線材兩端，讓伺服器和網路設備之間能高速傳送資料。源傑負責相關設計，聯鈞 (3450-TW)配合生產，較高速產品則隨客戶驗證逐步推進。雷射封裝之外，公司也有機會承接更多組裝與測試工作。
接下來我會看新增設備能否順利投入生產，以及高速產品驗證後的出貨進度。公司正持續增加雷射封裝產能，若客戶拉貨接得上，擴產就有機會轉成營收。柏林GTC釋出的光學引擎擴產方向，也讓這條產業的需求延續性更值得追蹤。聯鈞 (3450-TW)已有光通訊客戶與製造經驗，後續重點是把產品升級和新增產能，逐步落實到實際交貨。

paras_en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang discussed supply‑chain expansion at the GTC in Berlin, putting optical communication back in the market spotlight. Nvidia’s CPO switch has already entered production, and now the company is pushing further expansion of optical engines, indicating that high‑speed interconnects in data centers are beginning to require more actual capacity. Lianjun (3450‑TW), which packages laser chips and participates in optical‑communication product manufacturing, is affected by this shift, and the implications for its downstream business merit close study.

In a nutshell, CPO means placing the components that transmit and receive optical signals closer to the switch chip. AI servers constantly exchange data; as distances grow and speeds increase, the power consumption and transmission loss of traditional electrical signals become harder to manage. Switching to light for data transfer helps reduce this burden. An optical engine can be thought of as a small module that converts electrical signals to optical signals and vice‑versa; wider adoption of such engines in switches will drive up demand for related components and packaging.

Lianjun’s (3450‑TW) core competency is laser packaging. A laser chip must be mounted, wired, and tested before it becomes a usable light‑source component for customers. As power and transmission speeds rise, thermal management and packaging precision become more critical, and the company’s accumulated process experience becomes valuable. Research shows the firm’s product portfolio covers laser packaging for light‑module applications as well as co‑packaging of external light sources needed for optics, giving it a solid foundation to participate in this upgrade wave. Through its light‑module customers, Lianjun is part of the supply chain; the related data mention customers such as the U.S. optical‑communication company Coherent. Industry expansion helps unlock demand, but it should still be viewed separately from confirmed individual orders.

Operating results already show growth. Lianjun’s September revenue was about NT$1.289 billion, nearly double year‑over‑year. The latest research notes that shipments from the optical‑communication segment continue to rise and laser‑packaging demand is heating up. This figure includes other group businesses and cannot be fully attributed to CPO revenue; the clearer driver remains existing optical‑communication customers pulling more product and increased shipments.

The group also develops active optical fiber cables through Yuan‑Jie Technology. In plain terms, this integrates optoelectronic conversion components at both ends of the cable, enabling high‑speed data transfer between servers and networking equipment. Yuan‑Jie handles the design, Lianjun (3450‑TW) handles production, and higher‑speed products are being rolled out gradually as customers validate them. Beyond laser packaging, the company also has opportunities to take on more assembly and testing work.

Going forward, I will watch whether the new equipment can be brought online smoothly and the shipment pace after high‑speed product validation. The company is continuously expanding laser‑packaging capacity; if customer orders keep up, the expansion can translate into revenue. The optical‑engine expansion direction announced at Berlin GTC also makes the industry’s demand continuity worth tracking. Lianjun already has optical‑communication customers and manufacturing experience, and the next focus is to upgrade products and add capacity, gradually turning them into actual deliveries.

items.title: 華爾街巨鱷Griffin直言AI泡沫確實存在 但不代表該出清持股
items.title_en: Wall Street titan Griffin says AI bubble is real but it doesn't mean you should dump your holdings
paras: 華爾街巨擘城堡投資（Citadel）創辦人格里芬（Ken Griffin）表示，投資人「幾乎肯定」正身處人工智慧（AI）泡沫之中，但他並未因此建議出清AI股票。
格里芬周二(20日)在紐約舉行的城堡投資全球市場未來論壇上表示：「如果我們要用泡沫這個詞，這些泡沫退去後留下的事物，往往能改變世界。而挺過泡沫的企業，會成為未來數十年的市場領導者。」
這項議題的影響不僅限於科技股投資人。過去一年，AI建設一直是支撐股市的重要力量，許多指數基金與退休帳戶也因此持有相關部位。
當價格漲幅遠超過企業基本面所能支撐的程度，直到現實追上預期，便形成所謂的泡沫。城堡投資則是一家替高資產客戶與機構管理資金的避險基金。
不過，格里芬認為，從大局來看，即使市場看似出現泡沫，也未必是那麼嚴重的問題。
他回顧網路熱潮時表示：「任何經濟上的重大轉型，通常都伴隨著泡沫。」他並坦言，希望當年沒有賣掉亞馬遜股票。
他主張，挺過泡沫的企業往往能主導市場數十年，但並未進一步預言市場將崩盤。
城堡投資本身就是AI效益的案例：格里芬表示，能自主執行多步驟任務的AI代理，已將公司部分高階研究工作所需時間，從數周縮短至短短幾小時。
GPU如同機位 供過於求恐壓垮價格
格里芬將許多企業用來訓練與執行AI模型的繪圖處理器（GPU），比喻為航空公司的座位。
兩者的邊際營運成本都很低，也就是每多服務一名客戶，增加的成本相當有限，因此一旦供給超過需求，價格就可能大幅下滑。
他以2000年前後的電信熱潮為例，當時企業鋪設的光纖纜線超出需求，導致通訊價格下跌。他也質疑，已有五、六年歷史、如今仍能收取他所謂「驚人」租金的晶片，是否還能再維持這種行情五、六年。
格里芬表示，買方正變得更加挑剔，開始區分哪些工作值得使用OpenAI與Anthropic的高價模型，哪些則可交給較便宜的開源替代方案，也就是任何人都能下載並在自有電腦上執行的模型。
他補充，美國企業運用AI創造價值的成效參差不齊，不少公司正檢視AI開發商的帳單，追問生產力究竟提升在哪裡。
AI支出龐大 高價能否延續成關鍵
Gartner預估，2025年全球AI支出將接近1.5兆美元，涵蓋晶片、伺服器及具備AI功能的手機等各類產品。輝達(NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳今年1月在達沃斯表示，這場他所稱「人類史上最大規模的基礎建設浪潮」，目前才投入「數千億美元」，未來仍有數兆美元的建設待完成。
若客戶不願接受高價，仰賴這波支出的晶片與雲端業者將首當其衝。
7月30日，由前OpenAI研究員阿申布倫納（Leopold Aschenbrenner）創立的避險基金Situational Awareness，以約一成折價，將大部分上市股票投資組合出售給城堡投資。據報導，該投資組合的價值在7月下跌約67%。
這檔基金曾借入最高相當於自身資本4倍的資金買進AI股票，也就是運用槓桿。
隨著股價下跌，貸款方每天要求追加擔保品。因貸款方要求而非出於自願出售資產，稱為被迫賣出；這種情況會形成惡性循環，因為每次賣出都會進一步壓低價格，引發更多追加擔保品的要求。
格里芬在8月致客戶的信中寫道，城堡投資此後已削減該投資組合逾80%的風險。換言之，這位直言市場存在泡沫的投資人，也曾買進折價股票。
能源風險未消 資本支出增速料放緩
格里芬今年稍早警告，若重要石油運輸通道荷姆茲海峽持續封閉六至十二個月，能源價格將顯著上漲，並使全球陷入經濟衰退。
高盛研究部在12月指出，華爾街分析師預期，最大幾家AI基礎建設業者投入晶片與資料中心等項目的資本支出，成長率將從2025年第三季的75%，放緩至2026年底的25%。
paras_en: Citadel founder Ken Griffin said investors are "almost certainly" in an artificial‑intelligence (AI) bubble, but he did not advise selling AI stocks because of it.

Speaking on Tuesday (the 20th) at Citadel’s Global Markets Future Forum in New York, Griffin said, "If we have to use the word bubble, what remains after the bubble bursts often changes the world. Companies that survive the bubble will become market leaders for decades to come."

The issue matters not only to tech‑stock investors. Over the past year AI development has been a major driver of the market, and many index funds and retirement accounts now hold AI‑related positions.

When price gains far outpace what a company's fundamentals can support, a bubble forms until reality catches up with expectations. Citadel is a hedge fund that manages money for high‑net‑worth individuals and institutions.
Nevertheless, Griffin believes that, in the big picture, even if the market appears bubbly, it may not be a serious problem.
Recalling the internet boom, he said, "Any major economic transformation usually comes with a bubble." He also admitted he wishes he hadn't sold his Amazon shares back then.
He argues that companies that ride out a bubble often dominate the market for decades, but he did not go so far as to predict a market crash.
Citadel itself is an example of AI benefits: Griffin said AI agents that can execute multi‑step tasks have cut the time needed for some high‑level research projects from weeks down to a few hours.
GPUs are like airline seats – oversupply could crush prices.
Griffin likened the graphics processing units (GPUs) that many firms use to train and run AI models to airline seats.
Both have very low marginal operating costs – serving one more customer adds only a tiny expense – so when supply exceeds demand, prices can fall sharply.

He cited the telecom boom around 2000, when companies over‑installed fiber optic cable and communication prices dropped. He also questioned whether chips that have been charging what he calls "astonishing" rents for five or six years can keep that pricing for another five or six years.

Griffin said buyers are becoming more selective, distinguishing which tasks merit using high‑priced models from OpenAI and Anthropic and which can be handed to cheaper open‑source alternatives that anyone can download and run on their own hardware.
He added that U.S. firms’ results from using AI are mixed; many companies are scrutinizing AI vendors’ bills and asking where productivity gains are actually coming from.
AI spending is huge – will high prices persist as a key factor?

Gartner projects global AI spending will approach $1.5 trillion by 2025, covering chips, servers and AI‑enabled phones. Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang told Davos in January that the "largest infrastructure wave in human history" has so far seen "only a few hundred billion dollars" of investment, with several trillion dollars still to be spent.
If customers balk at high prices, chip makers and cloud providers that rely on this wave of spending will be hit first.

On July 30, Situational Awareness, a hedge fund founded by former OpenAI researcher Leopold Aschenbrenner, sold most of its public‑equity portfolio to Citadel at roughly a 10% discount. The portfolio had lost about 67% of its value in July.
The fund had previously borrowed up to four times its own capital to buy AI stocks, i.e., it used leverage.

As the stock price fell, lenders demanded daily margin calls. Because the sales were forced by lenders rather than voluntary, they are called forced sales; this creates a vicious cycle as each sale pushes the price lower and triggers more margin calls.

In an August letter to clients, Griffin wrote that Citadel has since reduced the portfolio’s risk by more than 80%. In other words, the investor who bluntly said a bubble exists has also bought discounted stocks.
Energy risk remains and cap‑ex growth is expected to slow.

Earlier this year Griffin warned that if the crucial oil‑shipping Strait of Hormuz stays closed for six to twelve months, energy prices would jump sharply and could plunge the global economy into recession.

Goldman Sachs research noted in December that Wall Street analysts expect capital spending by the biggest AI infrastructure players on chips and data centers to slow from a 75% growth rate in Q3 2025 to about 25% by the end of 2026.

items.title: 員工的隱形焦慮，擔心被資遣！如何替自己準備退路？
paras: 柏睿在知名外商科技公司擔任工程師，單身、沒有小孩，也沒有太多家庭負擔，穩定的高收入、優渥的員工福利，加上歷年累積的公司股票，讓他的生活看起來比多數同齡人更有餘裕，但他真正擔心的，從來不是現在賺得不夠，而是不知道這份高收入還能維持多久。
近年科技業頻繁傳出組織重整、部門整併與專案取消，就算自己在工作表現不差，也可能因為公司策略改變，突然失去原本穩定的職位。當收入、獎金與投資資產都集中在同一家公司，高薪帶來的可能不只是財富，也可能是自己尚未察覺的風險。
一次組織調整，讓他開始思考自己的退路
真正讓柏睿開始不安的，是一位熟悉同事的突然被資遣，前一天，兩人還在討論專案進度，隔天同事的座位便空了下來。這件事讓他第一次認真思考，如果下一個輪到自己，現在的存款可以支撐多久？下一份工作還能維持相同薪資嗎？如果找下份工作時間比預期更長，會因為收入中斷，被迫接受一份不適合的工作嗎？
以往柏睿認為自己單身、沒有家庭負擔，只要持續工作、存錢與投資，就不需要太擔心未來，但他逐漸發現，自己的薪資、獎金、員工福利與公司股票，幾乎都與公司連動。公司賺錢時，收入與資產可能同步成長，但當公司進行組織調整、股價又同時下跌時，也可能發生工作收入中斷、投資資產縮水的雙重壓力。因此他希望在風險真正發生以前，先確認自己是否已經準備好退路。
高薪可以加快資產累積，卻無法保證工作永遠穩定
面對被資遣的不安，柏睿需要的不是盲目增加存款，而是先回答一個更實際的問題。如果明天開始沒有薪水，現有資金可以讓自己維持原本的生活多久？因此永誠資產管理處先協助他盤點每月必要支出、可調整支出與年度固定支出，再根據職位、薪資條件及預估求職時間，規劃符合個人情況的職涯轉換準備金。
這筆準備金不能只計算房租、伙食、保費與日常生活費，還必須考量幾項容易被忽略的開銷：

預估求職空窗多久，是否需要預留更長的緩衝時間
平常是否依賴獎金、分紅或出售公司股票，支付固定開銷
離職後，原由公司提供的保險與福利，哪些需要自行負擔或另作安排
是否需要額外支付進修、考證照、面試交通或搬遷費用
若空窗期間同時遇到生病等突發狀況，是否還有資金可以支應


一般緊急預備金著重的是短期意外，但職涯轉換準備金的目的，是讓自己即使暫時沒有收入，也能保有選擇工作的餘裕，準備得越完整，就越不容易因為短期經濟壓力，匆忙接受不適合的職位。
薪資與資產，不應全部綁在同一家公司
柏睿的部分薪酬來自公司股票，當公司營運與股價表現良好時，公司股票確實能加快資產累積，但如果長期持有、沒有定期檢視，也可能讓職涯與資產集中在同一個風險來源。因此檢視公司股票不能只問未來會不會繼續上漲，還要同時確認公司股票占可投資資產多少比例，以及個人在近幾年有沒有買房、轉職或進修等資金需求。
當每一筆資金都有明確用途，即使職涯突然出現變化，也不需要在市場下跌時被迫出售長期投資，更不會因為帳面上看似擁有不少資產，實際需要用錢時卻無法靈活動用。
單身沒有家庭負擔，更需要多準備一步
單身代表柏睿目前只需要為自己負責，收入也有較高的運用彈性；但換個角度來看，當他失去收入、生病或需要照護時，也未必有另一份家庭收入可以共同分擔。現在的他擁有體力、專業與工作能力，即使轉職，仍有機會重新開始。但隨著年齡增加，職涯選擇、健康狀況與工作收入都可能改變，未來的醫療、照護與退休生活，也需要依靠自己提前準備。
因此單身族的財務規劃不能只停留在沒有家庭負擔，所以可以多花一點，而應該進一步思考，如果未來主要只能依靠自己，現在累積的資產，能否支撐職涯空窗、健康風險、長期照護，以及自己真正想過的生活？單身族需要準備的，不只是退休金，更是面對人生變化時，不必完全依賴別人的能力。
真正的安全感，是知道自己還有選擇
完成財務整理後，柏睿依然無法控制公司是否進行組織調整，也無法保證自己永遠不會被資遣，但他已經清楚知道，現有資金可以支撐多長時間、哪些支出可以調整、公司股票應該如何逐步分散，以及如果想暫時休息、進修或轉換跑道，可以動用哪一筆資金。

items.title: 有別於亞馬遜！沃爾瑪推出AI購物新工具：允許ChatGPT與Gemini等代理人直接下單
items.title_en: Unlike Amazon, Walmart Launches New AI Shopping Tool: Allows ChatGPT, Gemini and Other Agents to Place Orders Directly
paras: 美國零售巨頭沃爾瑪(Walmart)(WMT-US)周三(21日)推出自有的Agent Gateway平台及多項新功能，協助使用人工智慧(AI)代理人購物的顧客管理交易，搶占AI商務市場商機。最新舉措凸顯沃爾瑪積極擁抱AI代理式商務，而最大競爭對手亞馬遜(AMZN-US)不久前才開始封鎖代替網購消費者下單的AI代理人。
沃爾瑪擁抱AI技術的做法，不僅與亞馬遜不同，也與包括多家旅遊及訂房網站在內的其他線上業者形成對比。隨著消費者愈來愈常使用AI代理人，其他線上業者選擇全面封鎖AI代理人存取網站，相比照下，沃爾瑪先前已宣布與Meta Muse合作，也提供與OpenAI ChatGPT、Google Gemini等熱門AI應用程式的整合服務。

推出代理人管理功能 可設消費上限及逐筆審核

沃爾瑪表示，將於下月推出「Walmart Agent Profiles」功能，讓消費者授權個別AI代理人代為購物，並分別追蹤這些代理人所完成的交易。消費者也可設定支出上限，或要求每筆交易都必須經過本人核准。
沃爾瑪指出，顧客可以將AI代理人代為完成的購買紀錄，與自己下單的訂單分開查看，並可隨時撤銷代理人的存取權限。
瑞穗銀行(Mizuho)分析師David Bellinger表示，這些工具有助於提升消費者對這種仍處於「實驗階段」的代理式購物流程的信心，「……這股發展動能，加上高階管理團隊的支持，似乎正讓這件事逐漸成真。」

開放ChatGPT、Gemini等AI助理串接購物系統

沃爾瑪也推出「Walmart Agent Gateway」平台，讓OpenAI旗下ChatGPT、Google(GOOGL-US)旗下Gemini，以及Meta(META-US)旗下Muse等AI助理，能直接連結沃爾瑪與山姆俱樂部(Sam's Club)的系統，搜尋商品並完成購買。
沃爾瑪表示，消費者仍將掌握購物決策權。AI代理人不得存取支付卡資料，若違反公司規定，也可能遭到封鎖。所有沃爾瑪帳戶持有人都能使用這些工具，不需要訂閱Walmart+會員服務。
paras_en: U.S. retail giant Walmart (WMT-US) rolled out its own Agent Gateway platform and several new features on Wednesday (the 21st) to help customers using artificial‑intelligence (AI) agents manage transactions, aiming to capture opportunities in the AI commerce market. The move underscores Walmart’s proactive embrace of AI‑agent‑driven commerce, while its biggest rival Amazon (AMZN-US) only recently began blocking AI agents that place orders on behalf of shoppers.

Walmart’s approach to AI differs not only from Amazon’s but also from other online players, including numerous travel and hotel‑booking sites. As consumers increasingly rely on AI agents, many online operators have chosen to completely block AI agents from accessing their sites; in contrast, Walmart previously announced a partnership with Meta’s Muse and already offers integrations with popular AI applications such as OpenAI’s ChatGPT and Google’s Gemini.

The new agent‑management feature, called “Walmart Agent Profiles,” will launch next month, allowing shoppers to authorize individual AI agents to shop on their behalf and to track each agent’s transactions separately. Consumers can set spending limits or require that every transaction be approved by them personally.
Walmart notes that customers can view purchases made by AI agents separately from orders they place themselves and can revoke an agent’s access at any time.

Mizuho analyst David Bellinger said these tools help boost consumer confidence in what is still an “experimental” agent‑based shopping process, adding, “…this development momentum, combined with senior‑management support, seems to be gradually turning this idea into reality.”

Walmart also introduced the “Walmart Agent Gateway” platform, enabling AI assistants such as OpenAI’s ChatGPT, Google’s Gemini (GOOGL-US), and Meta’s Muse (META-US) to connect directly to Walmart and Sam’s Club systems, search for products and complete purchases.

Walmart emphasizes that shoppers retain full decision‑making authority. AI agents are prohibited from accessing payment‑card data and may be blocked if they violate company rules. All Walmart account holders can use these tools without needing a Walmart+ subscription.

items.title: 人工智慧疑慮再起 資金湧入美債、日元與瑞郎避險
items.title_en: AI Concerns Resurface, Funds Flood Into US Treasuries, Yen and Franc as Safe Havens
paras: 由於投資人對人工智慧(AI)交易的獲利前景疑慮再起，導致股市出現震盪，避險資金隨之湧入美國公債、日元及瑞士法郎等避險資產。
美國政府公債殖利率全線下跌至少 3 個基點，其中 30 年期美債殖利率降至 5.38%，創下 9 月 23 日以來最低。同時，澳洲與紐西蘭公債價格也同步走揚，日元兌美元匯率升幅高達 0.3%。
星展銀行(DBS Bank Ltd.)資深利率策略師 Eugene Leow 表示：「隨著投資人重新審視與 AI 相關的資產，近期的市場情緒似乎更加動搖。」他指出，市場對獲利能力與投資報酬率(ROI)的疑慮正在逐漸浮現。在美債殖利率以近期標準衡量仍處於高位的情況下，投資人希望透過轉向美債尋求安全感，以規避部分風險。
股票市場的跌勢，讓美債重新發揮了避險資產的作用；在此之前，對通膨升溫的擔擔曾推動美債殖利率在最近幾周升至多年新高。
儘管沙烏地阿拉伯發生的致命襲擊事件引發市場對供應前景的疑慮，進而推升原油價格，但資金對美債的避險買盤依然強勁。能源成本上升加深了市場對通膨的擔憂，並促使交易員預期美國聯準會(Fed)及全球其他主要中央銀行將進一步升息。
彭博追蹤美債報酬率的指標在 9 月創下近兩年來最大單月跌幅後，10 月已回升約 1.2%。
澳洲國家銀行(National Australia Bank)利率策略主管 Kenneth Crompton 對此指出：「儘管油價一直在緩步上揚，但美債再次吸引了避險資金的流入。」
除美債外，全球其他主要債市與匯市也受到影響。澳洲 10 年期公債殖利率下跌 3 個基點至 5.25%，紐西蘭 2 年期公債殖利率下滑 2 個基點至 3.91%。在匯市方面，日元兌美元升值 0.3% 至 157.68 日元兌 1 美元，瑞士法郎上漲 0.2%，而美元指數指標則變化不大。
法國Credit Agricole策略師 David Forrester 分析：「標普 500 指數期貨的回檔為日元帶來了推升力道。」他強調：「重要之處在於，這種升勢是全面性的，甚至對美元同樣上揚，這凸顯出在 AI 熱潮遭遇波折時，日元所具備的避險資產地位。」
paras_en: Investors' renewed doubts about the profit prospects of AI trading have caused stock market volatility, prompting safe‑haven money to pour into US government bonds, the Japanese yen and the Swiss franc.

US government bond yields fell across the board by at least three basis points, with the 30‑year Treasury yield dropping to 5.38%, the lowest since September 23. At the same time, Australian and New Zealand government bond prices rose, and the yen gained about 0.3% against the dollar.

Eugene Leow, senior rate strategist at DBS Bank Ltd., said: “As investors re‑evaluate AI‑related assets, market sentiment has become more unsettled.” He noted that concerns over profitability and ROI are emerging, and with Treasury yields still high by recent standards, investors are turning to US bonds for safety and to hedge some risk.
The equity market decline has restored the role of Treasuries as a safe‑haven asset; previously, worries about rising inflation had pushed Treasury yields up to multi‑year highs in recent weeks.

Although a deadly attack in Saudi Arabia raised supply‑side concerns and lifted oil prices, buying pressure for US Treasuries remained strong. Higher energy costs have deepened inflation worries and led traders to expect further rate hikes from the US Federal Reserve and other major central banks worldwide.
Bloomberg’s Treasury yield index, after posting the biggest monthly drop in nearly two years in September, has recovered about 1.2% in October.
Kenneth Crompton, head of rate strategy at National Australia Bank, said: “Even though oil prices have been inching higher, US Treasuries are once again attracting safe‑haven flows.”

Beyond Treasuries, other major bond and currency markets were also affected. Australian 10‑year government bond yields fell three basis points to 5.25%, New Zealand two‑year yields slipped two basis points to 3.91%. In the FX market, the yen appreciated 0.3% to 157.68 per dollar, the Swiss franc rose 0.2%, while the US dollar index was largely unchanged.

David Forrester, a strategist at Credit Agricole in France, analyzed: “The pull‑back in S&P 500 futures provided upward momentum for the yen.” He stressed: “The key point is that this rise is broad‑based, even lifting the dollar, highlighting the yen’s safe‑haven status when the AI hype hits a snag.”

items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Post‑Market: Typhoon “Saomai” Stirs Turbulence, Near 1,300‑Point Swing, Down 846 Points to a Low of 46,041.43
paras: 台北股市今(22)日開高走低，早盤一度收復4萬7000點大關，但中場過後受到美股期貨走弱、以及颱風「薔琵」攪局增添不確定因素，大盤表現失色、跌幅一路擴大，終場下跌846.34點，收最低46041.43點，高低震盪達1290.75點，成交值爲8792.31億元。

paras_en: Taipei’s stock market opened higher but turned lower on the 22nd. The index briefly reclaimed the 47,000‑point threshold in early trading, but after the mid‑session it was weighed down by weakening US futures and the added uncertainty from Typhoon “Saomai”. The market lost its shine, the decline widened, and it closed down 846.34 points at a low of 46,041.43, with a high‑low swing of 1,290.75 points and a turnover of NT$879.231 billion.

Typhoon Saomai hit, and the Central Weather Bureau issued a land‑based typhoon warning at 11:30 a.m. on the 22nd. Senior securities analyst Chien Po‑yi noted that the Taiwan market had rebounded yesterday and crossed the five‑day moving average, but investors feared that the typhoon would cause several days of market inactivity and that various international variables could interfere, prompting a reduction in holdings and a sharp sell‑off today.

TSMC (2330‑TW), still a major target for foreign‑fund withdrawals yesterday, rose 0.62 % to NT$2,435 in early trading, but later could not withstand the market‑wide selling pressure and fell below the NT$2,400 mark. The chipmaker closed at NT$2,385, down NT$35 from the previous day, a 1.45 % decline, with a volume of 22,000 lots.

Among other blue‑chip stocks, Hon Hai (2317‑TW) closed down NT$5, Delta Electronics (2308‑TW) fell NT$65 or 4 %, and MediaTek (2454‑TW) dropped NT$130 or 3.14 % to close at NT$4,010. In the IC substrate sector, Xinxing (3037‑TW), Nan‑Dian (8046‑TW) and Jing‑Shuo (3189‑TW) all fell, with Jing‑Shuo down NT$24 or 2.38 % to NT$986, slipping out of the “thousand‑dollar” stock range.

CCL‑type stock leader Taiwan Cement (2383‑TW) hit the limit‑up in early trading but the ceiling was lifted; the stock closed up NT$80 or 1.6 % at NT$5,070. Lian‑Mao (6213‑TW) rose, trading at NT$885 in the morning and setting a new intraday high, but closed at NT$777, down NT$46 or 5.59 % from the previous day.

items.title: 諾基亞轉型AI奏效 Q3獲利優於預期、明年光通訊業務拚增3成
items.title_en: Nokia's AI‑Driven Turnaround Pays Off: Q3 Profit Beats Expectations, Optical Networking to Grow 30% Next Year
paras: 人工智慧（AI）基礎建設投資激增，資料中心網路設備需求攀升，帶動諾基亞(NOK-US) 第三季獲利優於分析師預期。
這家總部位於芬蘭公司週四(22日)發布聲明指出，第三季調整後營業利益增至6.05億歐元（約6.8億美元），高於彭博彙整分析師平均預估的4.54億歐元，部分受惠於資料中心設備積壓訂單陸續出貨。
執行長Justin Hotard正尋求讓資料中心成為諾基亞更重要的成長動能。由於5G網路建置步調緩慢，傳統電信客戶的需求預料仍將低迷。他去年公布掌握AI基建熱潮的策略，同時推動重整，此後諾基亞已陸續出售多項事業。
諾基亞同時表示，已擴大重組規模，導致全年重組費用預計高達 11 億歐元，高於先前預估的 8 億歐元。
在 AI 與雲端客戶需求爆發的推升下，當季淨銷售額年增 10% 至 52 億歐元，略高於市場預期。
作為轉型布局的一環，諾基亞去年收購光通訊網路公司Infinera，預計2026年底前完成整合。公司預期，整合將帶來2億歐元的成本綜效，整體光通訊與IP網路業務2027年成長幅度最高可達30%。
AI基礎建設快速擴張，也為設備製造商帶來挑戰。記憶體晶片等零組件供應吃緊，價格隨之上漲。競爭對手愛立信(ERIC-US) 表示，已減輕相關衝擊，部分原因是客戶在合約協商期間，因預期價格將上漲而提前採購。
跡象顯示，諾基亞客戶也正提前下單。受惠於原訂第四季認列的部分營收提前入帳，行動基礎建設部門第三季銷售額年增5%，達29億歐元，高於分析師平均預估的28億歐元。
此外，諾基亞正與輝達(NVDA-US) 合作開發行動網路設備，採用這家美國晶片巨擘的先進晶片，而非完全依賴傳統電信網路專用的客製化晶片（ASIC）。
這項合作也是Hotard整體布局的一環，旨在讓諾基亞掌握AI運算從資料中心延伸至通訊網路的趨勢。
諾基亞股價周三在赫爾辛基收於8.23歐元，今年以來累計上漲約50%。
paras_en: AI infrastructure investment is soaring, boosting demand for data‑center networking gear and driving Nokia (NOK‑US) to post third‑quarter earnings that beat analyst forecasts.

The Finland‑based company said on Thursday (the 22nd) that adjusted operating profit for the quarter rose to €605 million (about $680 million), above Bloomberg’s consensus estimate of €454 million, helped in part by the gradual shipment of back‑logged data‑center equipment orders.

CEO Justin Hotard is pushing to make data centers a key growth engine for Nokia. With 5G roll‑out progressing slowly, demand from traditional telecom customers is expected to stay weak. He unveiled a strategy last year to ride the AI‑infrastructure wave while reshaping the business, and Nokia has since divested several units.
Nokia also said it has expanded the scale of its restructuring, leading to full‑year restructuring costs now expected to reach €1.1 billion, up from the previously forecast €800 million.
Fueled by exploding AI and cloud customer demand, quarterly net sales grew 10% year‑on‑year to €5.2 billion, slightly ahead of market expectations.

As part of its transformation, Nokia acquired optical‑network firm Infinera last year and aims to complete integration by the end of 2026. The company expects the integration to generate €200 million of cost synergies and sees overall optical and IP networking revenue potentially growing as much as 30% by 2027.

The rapid expansion of AI infrastructure also poses challenges for equipment makers. Tight supplies of components such as memory chips have pushed prices higher. Rival Ericsson (ERIC‑US) said it has mitigated the impact, partly because customers placed advance orders during contract negotiations anticipating price hikes.

Signs indicate Nokia’s customers are also ordering early. Benefiting from some fourth‑quarter revenue being recognized early, the Mobile Infrastructure segment’s Q3 sales rose 5% year‑on‑year to €2.9 billion, above analysts’ average forecast of €2.8 billion.

In addition, Nokia is partnering with Nvidia (NVDA‑US) to develop mobile network equipment that uses the U.S. chip maker’s advanced processors rather than relying solely on custom ASICs built for traditional telecom gear.
The partnership is part of Hotard’s broader strategy to extend AI computing from data centers into communications networks.
Nokia’s shares closed at €8.23 in Helsinki on Wednesday, up about 50% so far this year.

items.title_en: Value Investing Latest Industry Research Report: Lianjun (3450‑TW) Optical‑Communication Shipments Warm Up, Laser Packaging Welcomes Expansion Opportunities
paras: 黃仁勳在柏林GTC談供應鏈擴產，光通訊又成了市場焦點。輝達的CPO交換器先前已宣布進入生產，這次進一步推動光學引擎擴產，代表資料中心的高速連線開始需要更多實際產能。聯鈞 (3450-TW)做雷射晶片封裝，也參與光通訊產品生產，這波變化和它後面的生意有什麼關係，值得研究清楚。
先用一句話理解CPO：把負責收發光訊號的元件，放到更靠近交換器晶片的位置。人工智慧伺服器之間得不停交換資料，距離拉長、速度提高，傳統電訊號的耗電與傳輸損耗就更難處理。改用光來傳資料，有助於降低這段負擔。光學引擎可以想成把電訊號與光訊號互相轉換的小型組件，交換器擴大採用，相關零組件和封裝需求也會跟著增加。

聯鈞 (3450-TW)的專長在雷射封裝。雷射晶片要固定、接線，再經過測試，才能成為客戶能使用的光源元件。功率和傳輸速度提高後，散熱與封裝精度都更重要，長期累積的製程經驗就有用武之地。研究資料顯示，公司產品布局涵蓋供光模組使用的雷射封裝，以及共同封裝光學所需的外接光源，具備參與這波升級的基礎。公司透過光模組客戶參與供應鏈，相關資料提到的客戶包括美國光通訊廠Coherent。產業擴產有助於打開需求，但目前仍應和已確認的個別訂單分開看。
營運已有成長可以對照。聯鈞 (3450-TW)的9月營收約12.89億元，比去年同期接近翻倍。最新研究資料指出，光通訊部門出貨持續增加，雷射封裝需求也在升溫。這個數字包含集團其他業務，不能全部算成CPO收入；目前較明確的動能，仍是既有光通訊客戶拉貨與產品出貨增加。
集團也透過源傑科技發展主動式光纖纜線。白話說，就是把光電轉換元件整合在線材兩端，讓伺服器和網路設備之間能高速傳送資料。源傑負責相關設計，聯鈞 (3450-TW)配合生產，較高速產品則隨客戶驗證逐步推進。雷射封裝之外，公司也有機會承接更多組裝與測試工作。
接下來我會看新增設備能否順利投入生產，以及高速產品驗證後的出貨進度。公司正持續增加雷射封裝產能，若客戶拉貨接得上，擴產就有機會轉成營收。柏林GTC釋出的光學引擎擴產方向，也讓這條產業的需求延續性更值得追蹤。聯鈞 (3450-TW)已有光通訊客戶與製造經驗，後續重點是把產品升級和新增產能，逐步落實到實際交貨。

paras_en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang discussed supply‑chain expansion at the GTC in Berlin, putting optical communication back in the market spotlight. Nvidia’s CPO switch has already entered production, and now the company is pushing further expansion of optical engines, indicating that high‑speed interconnects in data centers are beginning to require more actual capacity. Lianjun (3450‑TW), which packages laser chips and participates in optical‑communication product manufacturing, is affected by this shift, and the implications for its downstream business merit close study.

In a nutshell, CPO means placing the components that transmit and receive optical signals closer to the switch chip. AI servers constantly exchange data; as distances grow and speeds increase, the power consumption and transmission loss of traditional electrical signals become harder to manage. Switching to light for data transfer helps reduce this burden. An optical engine can be thought of as a small module that converts electrical signals to optical signals and vice‑versa; wider adoption of such engines in switches will drive up demand for related components and packaging.

Lianjun’s (3450‑TW) core competency is laser packaging. A laser chip must be mounted, wired, and tested before it becomes a usable light‑source component for customers. As power and transmission speeds rise, thermal management and packaging precision become more critical, and the company’s accumulated process experience becomes valuable. Research shows the firm’s product portfolio covers laser packaging for light‑module applications as well as co‑packaging of external light sources needed for optics, giving it a solid foundation to participate in this upgrade wave. Through its light‑module customers, Lianjun is part of the supply chain; the related data mention customers such as the U.S. optical‑communication company Coherent. Industry expansion helps unlock demand, but it should still be viewed separately from confirmed individual orders.

Operating results already show growth. Lianjun’s September revenue was about NT$1.289 billion, nearly double year‑over‑year. The latest research notes that shipments from the optical‑communication segment continue to rise and laser‑packaging demand is heating up. This figure includes other group businesses and cannot be fully attributed to CPO revenue; the clearer driver remains existing optical‑communication customers pulling more product and increased shipments.

The group also develops active optical fiber cables through Yuan‑Jie Technology. In plain terms, this integrates optoelectronic conversion components at both ends of the cable, enabling high‑speed data transfer between servers and networking equipment. Yuan‑Jie handles the design, Lianjun (3450‑TW) handles production, and higher‑speed products are being rolled out gradually as customers validate them. Beyond laser packaging, the company also has opportunities to take on more assembly and testing work.

Going forward, I will watch whether the new equipment can be brought online smoothly and the shipment pace after high‑speed product validation. The company is continuously expanding laser‑packaging capacity; if customer orders keep up, the expansion can translate into revenue. The optical‑engine expansion direction announced at Berlin GTC also makes the industry’s demand continuity worth tracking. Lianjun already has optical‑communication customers and manufacturing experience, and the next focus is to upgrade products and add capacity, gradually turning them into actual deliveries.

items.title: 員工的隱形焦慮，擔心被資遣！如何替自己準備退路？
paras: 柏睿在知名外商科技公司擔任工程師，單身、沒有小孩，也沒有太多家庭負擔，穩定的高收入、優渥的員工福利，加上歷年累積的公司股票，讓他的生活看起來比多數同齡人更有餘裕，但他真正擔心的，從來不是現在賺得不夠，而是不知道這份高收入還能維持多久。
近年科技業頻繁傳出組織重整、部門整併與專案取消，就算自己在工作表現不差，也可能因為公司策略改變，突然失去原本穩定的職位。當收入、獎金與投資資產都集中在同一家公司，高薪帶來的可能不只是財富，也可能是自己尚未察覺的風險。
一次組織調整，讓他開始思考自己的退路
真正讓柏睿開始不安的，是一位熟悉同事的突然被資遣，前一天，兩人還在討論專案進度，隔天同事的座位便空了下來。這件事讓他第一次認真思考，如果下一個輪到自己，現在的存款可以支撐多久？下一份工作還能維持相同薪資嗎？如果找下份工作時間比預期更長，會因為收入中斷，被迫接受一份不適合的工作嗎？
以往柏睿認為自己單身、沒有家庭負擔，只要持續工作、存錢與投資，就不需要太擔心未來，但他逐漸發現，自己的薪資、獎金、員工福利與公司股票，幾乎都與公司連動。公司賺錢時，收入與資產可能同步成長，但當公司進行組織調整、股價又同時下跌時，也可能發生工作收入中斷、投資資產縮水的雙重壓力。因此他希望在風險真正發生以前，先確認自己是否已經準備好退路。
高薪可以加快資產累積，卻無法保證工作永遠穩定
面對被資遣的不安，柏睿需要的不是盲目增加存款，而是先回答一個更實際的問題。如果明天開始沒有薪水，現有資金可以讓自己維持原本的生活多久？因此永誠資產管理處先協助他盤點每月必要支出、可調整支出與年度固定支出，再根據職位、薪資條件及預估求職時間，規劃符合個人情況的職涯轉換準備金。
這筆準備金不能只計算房租、伙食、保費與日常生活費，還必須考量幾項容易被忽略的開銷：

預估求職空窗多久，是否需要預留更長的緩衝時間
平常是否依賴獎金、分紅或出售公司股票，支付固定開銷
離職後，原由公司提供的保險與福利，哪些需要自行負擔或另作安排
是否需要額外支付進修、考證照、面試交通或搬遷費用
若空窗期間同時遇到生病等突發狀況，是否還有資金可以支應


一般緊急預備金著重的是短期意外，但職涯轉換準備金的目的，是讓自己即使暫時沒有收入，也能保有選擇工作的餘裕，準備得越完整，就越不容易因為短期經濟壓力，匆忙接受不適合的職位。
薪資與資產，不應全部綁在同一家公司
柏睿的部分薪酬來自公司股票，當公司營運與股價表現良好時，公司股票確實能加快資產累積，但如果長期持有、沒有定期檢視，也可能讓職涯與資產集中在同一個風險來源。因此檢視公司股票不能只問未來會不會繼續上漲，還要同時確認公司股票占可投資資產多少比例，以及個人在近幾年有沒有買房、轉職或進修等資金需求。
當每一筆資金都有明確用途，即使職涯突然出現變化，也不需要在市場下跌時被迫出售長期投資，更不會因為帳面上看似擁有不少資產，實際需要用錢時卻無法靈活動用。
單身沒有家庭負擔，更需要多準備一步
單身代表柏睿目前只需要為自己負責，收入也有較高的運用彈性；但換個角度來看，當他失去收入、生病或需要照護時，也未必有另一份家庭收入可以共同分擔。現在的他擁有體力、專業與工作能力，即使轉職，仍有機會重新開始。但隨著年齡增加，職涯選擇、健康狀況與工作收入都可能改變，未來的醫療、照護與退休生活，也需要依靠自己提前準備。
因此單身族的財務規劃不能只停留在沒有家庭負擔，所以可以多花一點，而應該進一步思考，如果未來主要只能依靠自己，現在累積的資產，能否支撐職涯空窗、健康風險、長期照護，以及自己真正想過的生活？單身族需要準備的，不只是退休金，更是面對人生變化時，不必完全依賴別人的能力。
真正的安全感，是知道自己還有選擇
完成財務整理後，柏睿依然無法控制公司是否進行組織調整，也無法保證自己永遠不會被資遣，但他已經清楚知道，現有資金可以支撐多長時間、哪些支出可以調整、公司股票應該如何逐步分散，以及如果想暫時休息、進修或轉換跑道，可以動用哪一筆資金。
永誠資產管理處所做的，不是預測資遣何時發生，而是從收支、資產集中度、職涯風險及長期生活目標出發，把原本模糊的不安，轉換成可以計算、可以準備，也可以逐步執行的財務安排。
真正的安全感，不是相信自己永遠不會失去工作，而是即使有一天薪水突然停止，仍然擁有足夠的時間、資金與選擇權，決定自己下一步要往哪裡走。

paras: 2026年10月22日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 全球航空維修需求持續升溫，長榮航太(2645-TW)受惠機隊老化與新機交付延宕，維修業務接單動能維持強勁，製造業務也有新廠及A321機身零組件訂單挹注。然而，產業前景看好，不代表獲利就能同步成長。近期股價承壓，市場可能更關注材料短缺、維修交期延長、人力成本及既有廠房產能瓶頸等因素，導致成長動能無法立即反映在獲利上。
從產業需求來看，國際航空運輸協會(IATA)公布的資料顯示，全球新機待交訂單已超過1.7萬架，機隊平均機齡升至15.1年。由於新機交付進度持續落後，航空公司被迫延長既有機隊使用年限，帶動定期檢修、零組件更換及機體結構維修需求增加，也為長榮航太提供穩定的接單基礎。
不過，航空維修產業目前最大的問題，已從有沒有訂單，轉向能不能順利完成維修並將訂單轉化為獲利。
IATA與Emerton於6月發布研究指出，LEAP及普惠GTF等新世代窄體客機發動機，仍面臨零件供應及維修能量不足問題。一旦關鍵料件延遲交付，不僅拉長飛機維修時間，也可能排擠後續飛機進廠時程，使業者即使接單滿載，營收與獲利仍難以快速提升。
這也是長榮航太短期營運面臨的挑戰。目前公司四座維修棚廠已接近滿載，第五座棚廠仍須等待桃園機場土地分配，意味著2027年維修業務難以依靠新增廠房大幅擴充產能。公司將透過增補技術人員、安排第二班及縮短維修周轉時間，提高既有棚廠的承接能力，但在人力培訓、班次調整及維修效率改善過程中，短期仍可能面臨成本增加及產能提升有限的壓力。
從國際同業表現，也能看出維修需求成長與獲利提升未必同步。

漢莎技術Lufthansa Technik今年上半年營收年增11%，但受到材料短缺、交貨延遲及匯率影響，調整後息稅前利益僅增加2%，利潤率降至7.1%。相較之下，新科工程ST Engineering商用航太部門同期營收年增15%、息稅前利益增加29%，主要受惠發動機維修、備品銷售成長，以及產品組合與生產效率改善，反映同樣處於航空維修需求擴張環境，不同業者的成本控制與產能效率，仍會造成明顯的獲利差異。
不過，長期來看，這些問題可能更偏向盈餘成長潛力何時釋放，而非成長動能本身出現轉折。 隨著航空維修需求持續增加，長榮航太若能逐步改善料件供應、提高既有棚廠使用效率，先前受到產能限制的接單需求，仍有機會轉化為實際營收與獲利。
除了維修業務，航太製造也將成為下一階段的成長動能。長榮航太觀音二廠預計2027年第二季完工、第三季開始投單生產，主要承接A321機身零組件。空中巴士9月指出，A320系列約7,500架待交訂單中，約75%為A321，顯示相關機型未來數年仍有龐大的生產需求，為長榮航太製造業務提供長期成長空間。不過，新廠投產後仍須經歷產能爬坡，實際出貨也取決於客戶生產排程，因此對營收與獲利的貢獻仍需要時間發酵。

paras_en: October 22, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Global demand for aircraft maintenance continues to heat up, and EVA Aerospace (2645‑TW) benefits from aging fleets and delayed new‑plane deliveries. Repair orders remain robust and the manufacturing side is bolstered by a new plant and A321 fuselage component orders. However, a bright industry outlook does not guarantee simultaneous profit growth. The recent share price decline suggests the market is focusing on material shortages, longer repair lead times, labor costs and existing plant capacity bottlenecks, which prevent growth momentum from being reflected in earnings right away.

From an industry demand perspective, data from the International Air Transport Association (IATA) show that global pending new‑aircraft orders exceed 17,000 units and the average fleet age has risen to 15.1 years. Because new‑plane deliveries remain delayed, airlines are forced to extend the service life of existing fleets, driving up needs for scheduled inspections, component replacements and structural repairs, providing EVA Aerospace with a stable order base.
Nevertheless, the biggest issue in the aircraft‑maintenance sector has shifted from whether orders exist to whether repairs can be completed smoothly and turned into profit.

A study released by IATA and Emerton in June noted that next‑generation narrow‑body engines such as LEAP and Pratt & Whitney GTF still face parts‑supply and repair‑capacity constraints. Delays in critical components not only lengthen aircraft repair times but can also push back subsequent aircraft arrivals, meaning that even with a full order book, revenue and profit may not rise quickly.

This is the short‑term operational challenge facing EVA Aerospace. Its four existing hangars are near full capacity, and a fifth hangar still awaits land allocation at Taoyuan Airport, meaning that by 2027 the company cannot rely on new facilities to dramatically expand repair capacity. EVA plans to add technicians, run a second shift and shorten turnaround times to boost the existing hangars’ throughput, but during the training, shift‑adjustment and efficiency‑improvement process, short‑term cost increases and limited capacity gains are likely.
International peers also show that rising repair demand does not automatically translate into higher profits.

Lufthansa Technik posted an 11% year‑over‑year revenue increase in the first half of the year, yet material shortages, delivery delays and currency effects limited its adjusted EBIT growth to 2% and pushed its profit margin down to 7.1%. By contrast, ST Engineering’s commercial aerospace division recorded a 15% revenue rise and a 29% increase in EBIT in the same period, driven by engine‑repair and spare‑parts sales as well as product mix and production‑efficiency improvements, illustrating how cost control and capacity efficiency create divergent profitability even in a expanding repair market.

In the long run, these issues are more about when earnings‑growth potential will be unlocked rather than a fundamental shift in growth momentum. As maintenance demand keeps rising, EVA Aerospace could convert previously capacity‑constrained orders into real revenue and profit if it gradually improves parts supply and boosts existing hangar utilization.

Beyond repairs, aerospace manufacturing will become the next growth driver. EVA’s Guanyin Plant 2 is slated for completion in Q2 2027 with production starting in Q3, focusing on A321 fuselage components. Airbus indicated in September that about 75% of the roughly 7,500 pending A320‑family orders are for the A321, signaling strong production demand for the model in the coming years and offering EVA long‑term manufacturing growth space. However, after the new plant comes online, capacity ramp‑up and actual shipments will depend on customer production schedules, so its contribution to revenue and profit will take time to materialize.

items.title: 內資軋空外資 光復台股！
items.title_en: Domestic Investors Squeeze Foreign Investors, Restoring Taiwan Stocks!
paras: EPFR統計至10/14當周，美國股票型基金淨流入近391億美元居冠，今年淨流入已逾3,450億美元，大部分都是買AI，但「VIX恐慌指數」10/16大漲22%，美股最強的費半指數10/7~10/16竟然連八跌，近日才初步止跌築底，道瓊指數及標普表現比科技股好，現在傳出中俄美三國峰會，11月俄烏可能停戰，美股醞釀反攻！台股在光復節前的10/21台指期結算，股匯市同步反轉了。

美銀證券對亞洲基金經理人的10月調查顯示，45%認為明年將出現AI泡沫，42%不認為。但這份問券結論：「外資都最看好台股，淨加碼台灣比率達50%，領先日韓；逾三成受訪者認為，在AI下一階段熱潮，台股最受惠」。但外資已連賣台股三年，前二年大賣6982億、5995億，今年逾2.11 兆，「史上六大單日外資賣超」都在今年發生，外資瘋狂在亞洲提款，中央銀行10/19罕見盤中喊話打強心針，10/21匯價貶到32.666，周線邁向連四黑，不過，反轉升到32.39，股匯都物極必反，台股也大漲594點，一度重返「4萬7」。
10月內資做多，融資10/12創新高6533億，指數最大回檔7.4%，融資只減少2.3%，信心太強了，10月正如3月、7月外資也大賣，但之後，台股很快V轉再創高，估計光復節後只要外資回補，就將挑戰5萬點了！10/21只見外資由大賣轉為小買9.6億，台指期空單已由10/16連續回補四天，一共1.1萬口。
7/16台積電法說會確定「加碼投資美國1000億美元」，次日外資就大賣1890億台股創紀錄；10/15法說會證實要在德州建第二園區，當天就創史上紀錄狂賣3026億台股。今年出口大旺，前三季出超1605億美元，但是外匯存底9月6007億美元，和去年10月6002億美元差不多，一年沒增加，錢都在海外，主要都在投資美國了！
台股今年漲幅到10/21達61.9%，大於費半的59.3%，也大於韓股的36%！9月底投信各類型基金規模增加3,040億，到16.74兆元，今年到10/21大買8949億，台股靠內資力捧，尤其是大買護國神山台積電，若只算外資今年大賣95.5萬張，金額逾2兆，只略小於外資賣出上市股的金額。按照張錫的看法，認為外資持有台股增加20多兆，賣出比例並不算高，但籌碼大增也影響台股推升速度。
今年台股上市櫃公司獲利大進補，上半年大賺3.6兆，創下歷年同期新高，全年估賺7.5兆以上，挑戰8兆，前三季大賺逾一個股本的公司挑戰180家，年增近六成。上半年賺超過十個股本：群聯187.4元、宜鼎166.4元、川湖110.9元，但近日許多千金股大跌，川湖一度跌破萬元，到10/21共49檔千金股仍是多頭的主角。

ASIC股王創意自10/6天價8750元拉回7005元煞車，10/21一度漲回8490元，營收連四個月創新高，EPS 54元，但是「富二代」創意及今天漲停板的精材，都勝過富爸爸台積電，沒有那麼多外資賣壓，才可能P/E拉到最高160倍；長線上看萬元。世芯-KY受惠3奈米AI加速器放量，9月營收99.79億，年增496％，已連三個月創新高，AWS的T3晶片大出貨，今年EPS 130元，股價居然不到創意的一半，也太低估了，投信10/2~10/21連買13天逾2653張，全力吃貨。

大摩9月中「降評」大立光，相隔僅短短一個月又光速改口「升評」，喊目標價 9,040元，僅次於高盛證券喊的11,000元。玉晶光(3406)引進3M，以每股869.6元參與私募48.1億，持股4.68%，也拚光通訊，今年EPS 36.1元，明年40元起跳，10/16創1220元天價，今天10/21又漲停。聯一光今年EPS 2.5元，跟炒熱門題材，10/21先創293.5元天價，但暴大量殺到跌停，也反應了投機風險。
9月外銷訂單創新高，Supermicro又大幅上修營收與毛利率，散熱的健策(3653)以及PCB、CPO光通訊相關族群，都是後續值得關注的重點。台股今漲 594點，跌深的韓股也大漲3.29%，今天結算外資回補3676口空單，仍高達8.6萬口空單，投信又大買129.2億軋空外資。
10/15最高峰的外資台指期空單9.7萬口，如今回補四天1.1萬口，但光復節連續假期前，買盤較觀望，颱風有可能週五影響，下週才更有利「光復台股」。萬寶34周年慶，破天荒把268元零售價的萬寶周刊，在10/22~10/26特惠價25元，歡迎在萬傳媒商城訂閱。

paras_en: EPFR data up to the week of October 14 shows U.S. equity mutual funds netting a record inflow of about $39.1 billion, bringing year‑to‑date net inflows to over $345 billion, most of it buying AI. However, the VIX fear index jumped 22% on October 16, and the strongest U.S. semiconductor index fell eight times between October 7‑16, only just beginning to bottom out. The Dow and S&P outperformed tech stocks, and with the upcoming China‑Russia‑U.S. summit and a possible cease‑fire in the Russia‑Ukraine war in November, U.S. markets are gearing up for a rebound. Taiwan’s stock market reversed together with the currency market at the October 21 settlement of the Taiwan index futures, just before the Restoration Day holiday.

Bank of America’s October survey of Asian fund managers found 45% expect an AI bubble next year, while 42% do not. The survey concluded: “Foreign investors are the most bullish on Taiwan stocks, with net buying reaching 50% of the market, ahead of Japan and South Korea; over 30% of respondents believe Taiwan will benefit the most in the next wave of AI hype.” Yet foreign investors have been selling Taiwan stocks for three consecutive years, dumping NT$698.2 billion and NT$599.5 billion in the prior two years, and more than NT$2.11 trillion so far this year. All six historic single‑day foreign‑seller records occurred this year as foreign capital rushed out of Asia. The central bank on October 19 unusually intervened during trading, and the exchange rate fell to 32.666 on October 21, with the weekly chart forming four consecutive black candles before rebounding to 32.39. Both stocks and the currency reversed, and the Taiwan index surged 594 points, briefly climbing back to the “47,000” level.

Domestic investors went long in October, with margin financing hitting a new high of NT$653.3 billion on October 12. The index’s biggest pullback was 7.4%, yet margin only fell 2.3%, showing strong confidence. October, like March and July, saw heavy foreign selling, but the market quickly V‑shaped higher. It is estimated that after the Restoration Day holiday, if foreign investors resume buying, the index could challenge the 50,000‑point mark. On October 21 foreign investors switched from heavy selling to a modest net purchase of NT$9.6 billion, and Taiwan futures short positions were covered for four consecutive days since October 16, totaling 11,000 contracts.

On July 16 TSMC announced a US investment of US$100 billion; the next day foreign investors sold a record NT$189 billion of Taiwan stocks. On October 15 the earnings call confirmed a second campus in Texas, triggering a historic sell‑off of NT$302.6 billion. Export demand has been strong this year, with a surplus of US$160.5 billion in the first three quarters, but foreign‑exchange reserves were only NT$600.7 billion in September, almost unchanged from NT$600.2 billion in October last year, indicating that cash is staying overseas, mainly invested in the United States.

By October 21 the Taiwan index had risen 61.9% year‑to‑date, outpacing the semiconductor index’s 59.3% and South Korea’s 36%. By the end of September, mutual‑fund assets grew by NT$304 billion to NT$16.74 trillion, and from the start of the year to October 21 domestic investors bought NT$894.9 billion of stocks, largely supporting the market, especially the “national treasure” TSMC. Foreign investors sold 955,000 lots this year, worth over NT$2 trillion, only slightly less than the amount they sold of listed stocks overall. According to analyst Zhang Xi, foreign holdings in Taiwan stocks have increased by more than NT$20 trillion, so the sell‑off ratio is not high, but the large influx of capital also affects the speed of price appreciation.

Taiwan listed companies have seen a huge profit surge this year, earning NT$3.6 trillion in the first half – a record high for the same period – and are projected to earn over NT$7.5 trillion for the full year, possibly reaching NT$8 trillion. In the first three quarters, 180 companies earned more than one times their share capital, a 60% year‑over‑year increase. Companies that earned more than ten times their share capital in the first half include Phison (NT$187.4), Yidong (NT$166.4) and Chuanhu (NT$110.9). Recently many “thousand‑dollar” stocks have fallen sharply; Chuanhu even dipped below NT$10,000, yet as of October 21, 49 thousand‑dollar stocks remain the market’s main drivers.

ASIC king Creative Technology pulled back from a record NT$8,750 to NT$7,005 on October 6, then rose to NT$8,490 on October 21. Revenue hit four‑month highs and EPS reached NT$54, but “second‑generation rich” Creative and today’s limit‑up stock Jingcai outperformed “father‑rich” TSMC, facing less foreign‑seller pressure, allowing its P/E to climb to a peak of 160×; long‑term analysts see a potential NT$10,000 price. Semiconductor‑chip maker Worldchip‑KY benefited from 3‑nm AI accelerator volume, posting NT$9.979 billion revenue in September, up 496% YoY, with three consecutive monthly records. Its AWS T3 chip shipped heavily, EPS is NT$130, yet its share price is less than half of Creative’s, suggesting severe undervaluation. Mutual funds bought 2,653 lots between October 2‑21, buying for 13 consecutive days.

Morgan Stanley downgraded Largan Precision in mid‑September, but within a month reversed to an upgrade with a target price of NT$9,040, second only to Goldman Sachs’ NT$11,000 target. Yujing Optical (3406) partnered with 3M, investing NT$4.81 billion in a private placement at NT$869.6 per share for a 4.68% stake, also pushing into optical communications; its EPS is NT$36.1 this year, expected to start at NT$40 next year, and it hit a record NT$1,220 on October 16, then hit the limit‑up again on October 21. Lianyi Optical posted EPS of NT$2.5, rode a hot theme, hit a record NT$293.5 on October 21 before plunging to the limit‑down, reflecting speculative risk.

September saw record‑high overseas orders; Supermicro sharply raised its revenue and gross‑margin forecasts. Cooling‑solution provider Jianshi (3653) and PCB, CPO optical‑communication groups are also key sectors to watch. The Taiwan index rose 594 points today, while the heavily fallen South Korean market jumped 3.29%. At settlement, foreign investors covered 3,676 futures short contracts but still held 86,000 short contracts overall, while mutual funds bought NT$12.92 billion to squeeze foreign sellers.

Foreign investors’ peak short position in Taiwan futures reached 97,000 contracts on October 15; they have covered 11,000 contracts over the past four days. However, ahead of the Restoration Day holiday the buying pressure is cautious, and a typhoon may affect Friday’s trading. The market is expected to be more favorable for “restoring” Taiwan stocks next week. items.title: 叫車平台要納管了！交通部預告修法 計程車放寬「一車多車隊」
items.title_en: Ride‑hailing Platforms to Be Regulated! Ministry of Transportation Announces Draft Amendments, Taxis to Relax “One Car, One Fleet” Rule
paras: 為因應智慧移動及網路叫車服務趨勢，促進計程車業健全發展，交通部今(22)日宣布，預告修正「計程車客運服務業申請核准經營辦法」部分條文草案，此次修正重點在網路叫車平台納入規範，強化營運責任及乘客保障外，針對駕駛部分也回應需求，放寬「一車多車隊」，讓計程車服務管理制度更符合現行產業發展，預告草案期後，將在11月底、12月初上路。
交通部指出，隨著網路叫車服務日益普及，民眾透過平台預約計程車已成為重要的叫車方式，相關平台的營運責任及管理機制亦受到社會關注；另一方面，計程車駕駛及業界長期反映現行營運規範對接單彈性的限制。
在網路叫車平台納入規範部分，交通部表示，為回應社會對網路叫車平台責任及管理的期待，本次修法明定「接受委託以網際網路平台提供計程車派遣服務者」納入計程車客運服務業規範，並要求業者於修法後1年內依法取得營業執照。
首先，未來網路叫車平台若實際從事計程車或其他車隊派遣服務，即屬計程車客運服務業，並負相當的營運及管理責任，包括維持服務品質、提供駕駛專業訓練、確認投保第三人責任險及處理消費爭議等，進一步釐清平台、駕駛與乘客三方間的權責關係。
第二，為強化消費者及駕駛權益，草案也規劃下列配套措施：(一)強化服務費管理；(二)保障乘客搭乘權益；(三)強化資訊及資安防護。

為回應駕駛營運需求，此次修法草案也放寬「一車多車隊」，以針對計程車駕駛及業界長期反映現行「一車僅能加入單一車隊」限制。交通部表示，考量現今派遣服務已逐步朝數位化、多元化發展，為增加駕駛接受派遣服務的彈性，修法將放寬相關限制，開放同一輛計程車得同時委託一家以上經營派遣業務之業者，並透過資訊技術及營運紀錄保存，進一步掌握派遣及服務紀錄，並釐清不同派遣業者間的服務歸屬及權責，在兼顧管理需求及行車安全的前提下，將增加駕駛接單機會及營運彈性。
另配合「一車多車隊」，草案也同步建立相關駕駛管理：(一)強化教育訓練及時數採認；(二)強化高風險駕駛管理；(三)建立駕駛權益申訴機制。
交通部表示，網路叫車服務快速發展，計程車產業營運模式持續轉變，相關管理制度有必要與時俱進，此次修法一方面將實際提供網路派遣服務的平台納入規範，強化其營運責任，草案預告期間，將持續聽取各界意見，並就相關規範及實務執行面進行檢視及完善，依程序推動後續法制作業，期望透過制度精進，兼顧乘客安全、駕駛權益及產業發展。
paras_en: In response to the trends of smart mobility and online ride‑hailing services and to promote the healthy development of the taxi industry, the Ministry of Transportation announced today (the 22nd) a draft amendment to certain provisions of the "Regulations on the Application and Approval for Taxi Passenger Transport Services". The focus of this amendment is to bring online ride‑hailing platforms under regulation, strengthen operational responsibilities and passenger protections, and, for drivers, relax the "one car, multiple fleets" restriction so that taxi service management better aligns with current industry development. After the draft notice period, the changes are expected to take effect at the end of November or early December.

The Ministry noted that as online ride‑hailing services become increasingly popular, the public’s use of platforms to book taxis has become a major way to hail a ride, drawing societal attention to the platforms’ operational responsibilities and management mechanisms. At the same time, taxi drivers and the industry have long complained that existing operating rules limit the flexibility of order taking.

Regarding the inclusion of online ride‑hailing platforms under regulation, the Ministry said that to meet societal expectations for platform responsibility and management, the amendment explicitly classifies "entities that accept commissions to provide taxi dispatch services via internet platforms" as part of the taxi passenger transport service sector, and requires such operators to obtain a business license within one year after the law takes effect.

First, any online ride‑hailing platform that actually engages in dispatching taxis or other vehicle fleets will be considered a taxi passenger transport service provider and will bear corresponding operational and management duties, including maintaining service quality, providing professional driver training, confirming third‑party liability insurance, and handling consumer disputes, thereby clarifying the rights and responsibilities among platforms, drivers and passengers.

Second, to strengthen consumer and driver rights, the draft also outlines the following supporting measures: (1) tightening management of service fees; (2) safeguarding passenger riding rights; (3) enhancing information and cybersecurity protection.

To address drivers’ operational needs, the draft also relaxes the "one car, multiple fleets" rule, responding to the long‑standing industry concern that a taxi can join only a single fleet. The Ministry explained that, given the digital and diversified evolution of dispatch services, the amendment will allow a single taxi to be commissioned by more than one dispatch operator, using information technology and operational record‑keeping to track dispatch and service logs, clarify service ownership and responsibilities among different operators, and, while meeting management and safety requirements, increase drivers’ order‑taking opportunities and operational flexibility.

In conjunction with the "one car, multiple fleets" provision, the draft simultaneously establishes related driver management measures: (1) strengthening education and training hour recognition; (2) enhancing management of high‑risk drivers; (3) creating a driver rights grievance mechanism.

The Ministry stated that the rapid growth of online ride‑hailing services and the ongoing transformation of taxi business models make it necessary for regulatory frameworks to keep pace. This amendment will bring platforms that actually provide online dispatch services under regulation and reinforce their operational duties. During the draft notice period, the Ministry will continue to solicit public feedback, review and refine the relevant rules and practical implementation, and proceed with subsequent legislative procedures, aiming to improve the system while balancing passenger safety, driver rights, and industry development.

items.title: 新機交不出、舊機繼續飛！長榮航太(2645)維修滿載，拚效率擴大接單
items.title_en: New Aircraft Delayed, Old Planes Keep Flying! EVA Airways Aerospace (2645) Maintenance Fully Booked, Boosting Efficiency to Expand Orders
paras: 2026年10月22日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 全球新機交付延宕，航空公司延長既有機隊使用年限，推升航空維修需求。長榮航太(2645-TW)現有棚廠接近滿載，將透過增補技術人員、安排第二班及提高維修周轉率，擴大承接量；製造業務則以A321機身零組件新案，增添後續成長動能。
國際航空運輸協會(IATA)今年公布的資料顯示，全球新機待交訂單已超過1.7萬架，機隊平均機齡升至15.1年。新機交付進度落後，使航空公司持續使用既有飛機，帶動定期檢修、零組件更換及機體結構維修需求。
不過，維修需求暢旺，業者也面臨料件與人力不足的限制。IATA與Emerton於6月發布研究指出，LEAP與普惠GTF等新世代窄體客機發動機，仍有零件供應及維修能量不足問題。料件若未能及時到位，將拉長維修時間，影響後續接單與交付。
長榮航太目前四座棚廠接近滿載，第五座棚廠仍待桃園機場土地分配，2027年維修業務將以既有產能效率提升為主。透過人力補充、班次調整及縮短飛機進出廠時間，在新增棚廠到位前，提高既有設施的承接能力。
國際同業營運也呈現需求成長、獲利表現分歧的情況。漢莎技術Lufthansa Technik今年上半年營收年增11%，但受材料短缺、交貨延遲及匯率影響，調整後息稅前利益僅增2%，利潤率降至7.1%。新科工程ST Engineering商用航太部門同期營收年增15%、息稅前利益增29%，主要受惠發動機維修、備品銷售增加，以及產品組合與生產效率改善。
製造業務方面，長榮航太觀音二廠預計2027年第二季完工、第三季開始投單生產，承接A321機身零組件。空中巴士9月指出，A320系列約7,500架待交訂單中，約75%為A321，相關零組件需求具長期支撐。長榮航太後續出貨仍須配合新廠投產及客戶生產排程。

paras_en: October 22, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Global new‑aircraft deliveries are lagging, prompting airlines to extend the service life of existing fleets and driving up demand for aviation maintenance. EVA Airways Aerospace (2645‑TW) now has its hangar capacity nearly full and will increase technical staff, add a second shift and raise repair turnaround rates to take on more work; its manufacturing side is adding a new A321 fuselage component project to fuel future growth.

Data released by the International Air Transport Association (IATA) this year shows that worldwide pending new‑aircraft orders exceed 17,000 units, pushing the average fleet age up to 15.1 years. The slowdown in new‑aircraft deliveries means airlines keep using older planes, boosting demand for scheduled inspections, component replacements and airframe repairs.

However, strong maintenance demand also meets constraints in parts supply and labor. A study by IATA and Emerton released in June noted that next‑generation narrow‑body engines such as LEAP and Pratt & Whitney GTF still face shortages of parts and repair capacity. If parts are not delivered on time, repair cycles lengthen, hurting subsequent order intake and deliveries.

EVA Airways Aerospace’s four existing hangars are nearly at capacity, while a fifth hangar awaits land allocation at Taoyuan Airport. In 2027 the company will focus on improving efficiency of current capacity. By adding staff, adjusting shift patterns and shortening aircraft in‑and‑out times, it aims to raise the handling capability of existing facilities before the new hangar is ready.

International peers also show mixed demand growth and profitability. Lufthansa Technik reported an 11% year‑over‑year revenue increase in the first half of the year, but material shortages, delivery delays and currency effects limited adjusted EBIT growth to 2% and pushed profit margins down to 7.1%. ST Engineering’s commercial aerospace division posted a 15% revenue rise and a 29% EBIT increase, driven by higher engine‑repair work, spare‑parts sales and improved product mix and production efficiency.

On the manufacturing side, EVA Airways Aerospace’s Guanyin Plant 2 is slated for completion in Q2 2027, with production orders to start in Q3, taking on A321 fuselage components. Airbus indicated in September that of roughly 7,500 pending A320‑family orders, about 75% are for the A321, providing long‑term demand for related parts. EVA’s future shipments will depend on the new plant’s start‑up and customer production schedules.

items.title: 華爾街巨鱷Griffin直言AI泡沫確實存在 但不代表該出清持股
items.title_en: Wall Street titan Griffin says AI bubble is real but it doesn't mean you should dump your holdings
paras: 華爾街巨擘城堡投資（Citadel）創辦人格里芬（Ken Griffin）表示，投資人「幾乎肯定」正身處人工智慧（AI）泡沫之中，但他並未因此建議出清AI股票。
格里芬周二(20日)在紐約舉行的城堡投資全球市場未來論壇上表示：「如果我們要用泡沫這個詞，這些泡沫退去後留下的事物，往往能改變世界。而挺過泡沫的企業，會成為未來數十年的市場領導者。」
這項議題的影響不僅限於科技股投資人。過去一年，AI建設一直是支撐股市的重要力量，許多指數基金與退休帳戶也因此持有相關部位。
當價格漲幅遠超過企業基本面所能支撐的程度，直到現實追上預期，便形成所謂的泡沫。城堡投資則是一家替高資產客戶與機構管理資金的避險基金。
不過，格里芬認為，從大局來看，即使市場看似出現泡沫，也未必是那麼嚴重的問題。
他回顧網路熱潮時表示：「任何經濟上的重大轉型，通常都伴隨著泡沫。」他並坦言，希望當年沒有賣掉亞馬遜股票。
他主張，挺過泡沫的企業往往能主導市場數十年，但並未進一步預言市場將崩盤。
城堡投資本身就是AI效益的案例：格里芬表示，能自主執行多步驟任務的AI代理，已將公司部分高階研究工作所需時間，從數周縮短至短短幾小時。
GPU如同機位 供過於求恐壓垮價格
格里芬將許多企業用來訓練與執行AI模型的繪圖處理器（GPU），比喻為航空公司的座位。
兩者的邊際營運成本都很低，也就是每多服務一名客戶，增加的成本相當有限，因此一旦供給超過需求，價格就可能大幅下滑。
他以2000年前後的電信熱潮為例，當時企業鋪設的光纖纜線超出需求，導致通訊價格下跌。他也質疑，已有五、六年歷史、如今仍能收取他所謂「驚人」租金的晶片，是否還能再維持這種行情五、六年。
格里芬表示，買方正變得更加挑剔，開始區分哪些工作值得使用OpenAI與Anthropic的高價模型，哪些則可交給較便宜的開源替代方案，也就是任何人都能下載並在自有電腦上執行的模型。
他補充，美國企業運用AI創造價值的成效參差不齊，不少公司正檢視AI開發商的帳單，追問生產力究竟提升在哪裡。
AI支出龐大 高價能否延續成關鍵
Gartner預估，2025年全球AI支出將接近1.5兆美元，涵蓋晶片、伺服器及具備AI功能的手機等各類產品。輝達(NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳今年1月在達沃斯表示，這場他所稱「人類史上最大規模的基礎建設浪潮」，目前才投入「數千億美元」，未來仍有數兆美元的建設待完成。
若客戶不願接受高價，仰賴這波支出的晶片與雲端業者將首當其衝。
7月30日，由前OpenAI研究員阿申布倫納（Leopold Aschenbrenner）創立的避險基金Situational Awareness，以約一成折價，將大部分上市股票投資組合出售給城堡投資。據報導，該投資組合的價值在7月下跌約67%。
這檔基金曾借入最高相當於自身資本4倍的資金買進AI股票，也就是運用槓桿。
隨著股價下跌，貸款方每天要求追加擔保品。因貸款方要求而非出於自願出售資產，稱為被迫賣出；這種情況會形成惡性循環，因為每次賣出都會進一步壓低價格，引發更多追加擔保品的要求。
格里芬在8月致客戶的信中寫道，城堡投資此後已削減該投資組合逾80%的風險。換言之，這位直言市場存在泡沫的投資人，也曾買進折價股票。
能源風險未消 資本支出增速料放緩
格里芬今年稍早警告，若重要石油運輸通道荷姆茲海峽持續封閉六至十二個月，能源價格將顯著上漲，並使全球陷入經濟衰退。
高盛研究部在12月指出，華爾街分析師預期，最大幾家AI基礎建設業者投入晶片與資料中心等項目的資本支出，成長率將從2025年第三季的75%，放緩至2026年底的25%。
paras_en: Citadel founder Ken Griffin said investors are "almost certainly" in an artificial‑intelligence (AI) bubble, but he did not advise selling AI stocks because of it.

Speaking on Tuesday (the 20th) at Citadel’s Global Markets Future Forum in New York, Griffin said, "If we have to use the word bubble, what remains after the bubble bursts often changes the world. Companies that survive the bubble will become market leaders for decades to come."

The issue matters not only to tech‑stock investors. Over the past year AI development has been a major driver of the market, and many index funds and retirement accounts now hold AI‑related positions.

When price gains far outpace what a company's fundamentals can support, a bubble forms until reality catches up with expectations. Citadel is a hedge fund that manages money for high‑net‑worth individuals and institutions.
Nevertheless, Griffin believes that, in the big picture, even if the market appears bubbly, it may not be a serious problem.
Recalling the internet boom, he said, "Any major economic transformation usually comes with a bubble." He also admitted he wishes he hadn't sold his Amazon shares back then.
He argues that companies that ride out a bubble often dominate the market for decades, but he did not go so far as to predict a market crash.
Citadel itself is an example of AI benefits: Griffin said AI agents that can execute multi‑step tasks have cut the time needed for some high‑level research projects from weeks down to a few hours.
GPUs are like airline seats – oversupply could crush prices.
Griffin likened the graphics processing units (GPUs) that many firms use to train and run AI models to airline seats.
Both have very low marginal operating costs – serving one more customer adds only a tiny expense – so when supply exceeds demand, prices can fall sharply.

He cited the telecom boom around 2000, when companies over‑installed fiber optic cable and communication prices dropped. He also questioned whether chips that have been charging what he calls "astonishing" rents for five or six years can keep that pricing for another five or six years.

Griffin said buyers are becoming more selective, distinguishing which tasks merit using high‑priced models from OpenAI and Anthropic and which can be handed to cheaper open‑source alternatives that anyone can download and run on their own hardware.
He added that U.S. firms’ results from using AI are mixed; many companies are scrutinizing AI vendors’ bills and asking where productivity gains are actually coming from.
AI spending is huge – will high prices persist as a key factor?

Gartner projects global AI spending will approach $1.5 trillion by 2025, covering chips, servers and AI‑enabled phones. Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang told Davos in January that the "largest infrastructure wave in human history" has so far seen "only a few hundred billion dollars" of investment, with several trillion dollars still to be spent.
If customers balk at high prices, chip makers and cloud providers that rely on this wave of spending will be hit first.

On July 30, Situational Awareness, a hedge fund founded by former OpenAI researcher Leopold Aschenbrenner, sold most of its public‑equity portfolio to Citadel at roughly a 10% discount. The portfolio had lost about 67% of its value in July.
The fund had previously borrowed up to four times its own capital to buy AI stocks, i.e., it used leverage.

As the stock price fell, lenders demanded daily margin calls. Because the sales were forced by lenders rather than voluntary, they are called forced sales; this creates a vicious cycle as each sale pushes the price lower and triggers more margin calls.

In an August letter to clients, Griffin wrote that Citadel has since reduced the portfolio’s risk by more than 80%. In other words, the investor who bluntly said a bubble exists has also bought discounted stocks.
Energy risk remains and cap‑ex growth is expected to slow.

Earlier this year Griffin warned that if the crucial oil‑shipping Strait of Hormuz stays closed for six to twelve months, energy prices would jump sharply and could plunge the global economy into recession.

Goldman Sachs research noted in December that Wall Street analysts expect capital spending by the biggest AI infrastructure players on chips and data centers to slow from a 75% growth rate in Q3 2025 to about 25% by the end of 2026.

items.title: 有別於亞馬遜！沃爾瑪推出AI購物新工具：允許ChatGPT與Gemini等代理人直接下單
items.title_en: Unlike Amazon, Walmart Launches New AI Shopping Tool: Allows ChatGPT, Gemini and Other Agents to Place Orders Directly
paras: 美國零售巨頭沃爾瑪(Walmart)(WMT-US)周三(21日)推出自有的Agent Gateway平台及多項新功能，協助使用人工智慧(AI)代理人購物的顧客管理交易，搶占AI商務市場商機。最新舉措凸顯沃爾瑪積極擁抱AI代理式商務，而最大競爭對手亞馬遜(AMZN-US)不久前才開始封鎖代替網購消費者下單的AI代理人。
沃爾瑪擁抱AI技術的做法，不僅與亞馬遜不同，也與包括多家旅遊及訂房網站在內的其他線上業者形成對比。隨著消費者愈來愈常使用AI代理人，其他線上業者選擇全面封鎖AI代理人存取網站，相比照下，沃爾瑪先前已宣布與Meta Muse合作，也提供與OpenAI ChatGPT、Google Gemini等熱門AI應用程式的整合服務。

推出代理人管理功能 可設消費上限及逐筆審核

沃爾瑪表示，將於下月推出「Walmart Agent Profiles」功能，讓消費者授權個別AI代理人代為購物，並分別追蹤這些代理人所完成的交易。消費者也可設定支出上限，或要求每筆交易都必須經過本人核准。
沃爾瑪指出，顧客可以將AI代理人代為完成的購買紀錄，與自己下單的訂單分開查看，並可隨時撤銷代理人的存取權限。
瑞穗銀行(Mizuho)分析師David Bellinger表示，這些工具有助於提升消費者對這種仍處於「實驗階段」的代理式購物流程的信心，「……這股發展動能，加上高階管理團隊的支持，似乎正讓這件事逐漸成真。」

開放ChatGPT、Gemini等AI助理串接購物系統

沃爾瑪也推出「Walmart Agent Gateway」平台，讓OpenAI旗下ChatGPT、Google(GOOGL-US)旗下Gemini，以及Meta(META-US)旗下Muse等AI助理，能直接連結沃爾瑪與山姆俱樂部(Sam's Club)的系統，搜尋商品並完成購買。
沃爾瑪表示，消費者仍將掌握購物決策權。AI代理人不得存取支付卡資料，若違反公司規定，也可能遭到封鎖。所有沃爾瑪帳戶持有人都能使用這些工具，不需要訂閱Walmart+會員服務。
paras_en: U.S. retail giant Walmart (WMT-US) rolled out its own Agent Gateway platform and several new features on Wednesday (the 21st) to help customers using artificial‑intelligence (AI) agents manage transactions, aiming to capture opportunities in the AI commerce market. The move underscores Walmart’s proactive embrace of AI‑agent‑driven commerce, while its biggest rival Amazon (AMZN-US) only recently began blocking AI agents that place orders on behalf of shoppers.

Walmart’s approach to AI differs not only from Amazon’s but also from other online players, including numerous travel and hotel‑booking sites. As consumers increasingly rely on AI agents, many online operators have chosen to completely block AI agents from accessing their sites; in contrast, Walmart previously announced a partnership with Meta’s Muse and already offers integrations with popular AI applications such as OpenAI’s ChatGPT and Google’s Gemini.

The new agent‑management feature, called “Walmart Agent Profiles,” will launch next month, allowing shoppers to authorize individual AI agents to shop on their behalf and to track each agent’s transactions separately. Consumers can set spending limits or require that every transaction be approved by them personally.
Walmart notes that customers can view purchases made by AI agents separately from orders they place themselves and can revoke an agent’s access at any time.

Mizuho analyst David Bellinger said these tools help boost consumer confidence in what is still an “experimental” agent‑based shopping process, adding, “…this development momentum, combined with senior‑management support, seems to be gradually turning this idea into reality.”

Walmart also introduced the “Walmart Agent Gateway” platform, enabling AI assistants such as OpenAI’s ChatGPT, Google’s Gemini (GOOGL-US), and Meta’s Muse (META-US) to connect directly to Walmart and Sam’s Club systems, search for products and complete purchases.

Walmart emphasizes that shoppers retain full decision‑making authority. AI agents are prohibited from accessing payment‑card data and may be blocked if they violate company rules. All Walmart account holders can use these tools without needing a Walmart+ subscription.

items.title: 諾基亞轉型AI奏效 Q3獲利優於預期、明年光通訊業務拚增3成
items.title_en: Nokia's AI‑Driven Turnaround Pays Off: Q3 Profit Beats Expectations, Optical Networking to Grow 30% Next Year
paras: 人工智慧（AI）基礎建設投資激增，資料中心網路設備需求攀升，帶動諾基亞(NOK-US) 第三季獲利優於分析師預期。
這家總部位於芬蘭公司週四(22日)發布聲明指出，第三季調整後營業利益增至6.05億歐元（約6.8億美元），高於彭博彙整分析師平均預估的4.54億歐元，部分受惠於資料中心設備積壓訂單陸續出貨。
執行長Justin Hotard正尋求讓資料中心成為諾基亞更重要的成長動能。由於5G網路建置步調緩慢，傳統電信客戶的需求預料仍將低迷。他去年公布掌握AI基建熱潮的策略，同時推動重整，此後諾基亞已陸續出售多項事業。
諾基亞同時表示，已擴大重組規模，導致全年重組費用預計高達 11 億歐元，高於先前預估的 8 億歐元。
在 AI 與雲端客戶需求爆發的推升下，當季淨銷售額年增 10% 至 52 億歐元，略高於市場預期。
作為轉型布局的一環，諾基亞去年收購光通訊網路公司Infinera，預計2026年底前完成整合。公司預期，整合將帶來2億歐元的成本綜效，整體光通訊與IP網路業務2027年成長幅度最高可達30%。
AI基礎建設快速擴張，也為設備製造商帶來挑戰。記憶體晶片等零組件供應吃緊，價格隨之上漲。競爭對手愛立信(ERIC-US) 表示，已減輕相關衝擊，部分原因是客戶在合約協商期間，因預期價格將上漲而提前採購。
跡象顯示，諾基亞客戶也正提前下單。受惠於原訂第四季認列的部分營收提前入帳，行動基礎建設部門第三季銷售額年增5%，達29億歐元，高於分析師平均預估的28億歐元。
此外，諾基亞正與輝達(NVDA-US) 合作開發行動網路設備，採用這家美國晶片巨擘的先進晶片，而非完全依賴傳統電信網路專用的客製化晶片（ASIC）。
這項合作也是Hotard整體布局的一環，旨在讓諾基亞掌握AI運算從資料中心延伸至通訊網路的趨勢。
諾基亞股價周三在赫爾辛基收於8.23歐元，今年以來累計上漲約50%。
paras_en: AI infrastructure investment is soaring, boosting demand for data‑center networking gear and driving Nokia (NOK‑US) to post third‑quarter earnings that beat analyst forecasts.

The Finland‑based company said on Thursday (the 22nd) that adjusted operating profit for the quarter rose to €605 million (about $680 million), above Bloomberg’s consensus estimate of €454 million, helped in part by the gradual shipment of back‑logged data‑center equipment orders.

CEO Justin Hotard is pushing to make data centers a key growth engine for Nokia. With 5G roll‑out progressing slowly, demand from traditional telecom customers is expected to stay weak. He unveiled a strategy last year to ride the AI‑infrastructure wave while reshaping the business, and Nokia has since divested several units.
Nokia also said it has expanded the scale of its restructuring, leading to full‑year restructuring costs now expected to reach €1.1 billion, up from the previously forecast €800 million.
Fueled by exploding AI and cloud customer demand, quarterly net sales grew 10% year‑on‑year to €5.2 billion, slightly ahead of market expectations.

As part of its transformation, Nokia acquired optical‑network firm Infinera last year and aims to complete integration by the end of 2026. The company expects the integration to generate €200 million of cost synergies and sees overall optical and IP networking revenue potentially growing as much as 30% by 2027.

The rapid expansion of AI infrastructure also poses challenges for equipment makers. Tight supplies of components such as memory chips have pushed prices higher. Rival Ericsson (ERIC‑US) said it has mitigated the impact, partly because customers placed advance orders during contract negotiations anticipating price hikes.

Signs indicate Nokia’s customers are also ordering early. Benefiting from some fourth‑quarter revenue being recognized early, the Mobile Infrastructure segment’s Q3 sales rose 5% year‑on‑year to €2.9 billion, above analysts’ average forecast of €2.8 billion.

In addition, Nokia is partnering with Nvidia (NVDA‑US) to develop mobile network equipment that uses the U.S. chip maker’s advanced processors rather than relying solely on custom ASICs built for traditional telecom gear.
The partnership is part of Hotard’s broader strategy to extend AI computing from data centers into communications networks.
Nokia’s shares closed at €8.23 in Helsinki on Wednesday, up about 50% so far this year.

paras: 2026年10月22日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 【IBM上調軟體成長下限 訂單回補後續需求受關注】
2026年10月21日(優分析產業數據中心) - IBM(IBM-US)第三季大型軟體交易陸續入帳，帶動軟體營收與獲利率同步提升，公司將2026年全年軟體營收成長預估由6%至8%，調整為7%至8%，均按固定匯率計算。不過，全年整體營收展望維持不變，遞延訂單回補後的需求延續性，仍是市場觀察重點。
財務長James Kavanaugh表示，第二季延後的大型交易，約三分之二已在第三季完成，加上當季新業務挹注，軟體營收達78.04億美元，年增約8%，固定匯率成長約9%。軟體部門獲利達27.34億美元，獲利率由去年同期32.9%升至35%。

財報公布前，分析師已關注延後的軟體交易能否在第三、四季轉為營收，以判斷先前疲弱究竟是採購時程遞延，還是需求減少。摩根士丹利認為，遞延交易成交與成本節省有助支撐短期表現，但第三季之後仍須面對較高比較基期及競爭加劇的壓力。

paras_en: October 22, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – IBM raises the lower end of its software growth outlook as order replenishment draws attention to future demand.

October 21, 2026 (U-Analysis Industry Data Center) – IBM (IBM-US) recorded large software deals in the third quarter, boosting both software revenue and profit margin. The company revised its full‑year 2026 software revenue growth estimate from 6%‑8% to 7%‑8%, all on a constant‑currency basis. The overall revenue outlook for the year remains unchanged, and the sustainability of demand after the backlog catch‑up remains a key market focus.

Chief Financial Officer James Kavanaugh said that about two‑thirds of the large deals delayed in Q2 were completed in Q3, and together with new business in the quarter, software revenue reached $7.804 billion, up roughly 8% year‑over‑year and about 9% on a constant‑currency basis. Software segment profit was $2.734 billion, with the margin rising from 32.9% a year ago to 35%.

Transaction‑processing software was a growth driver this quarter, with constant‑currency revenue up 10%, mainly benefiting from increased mainframe workloads that spurred demand for enterprise transaction software. However, CEO Arvind Krishna cautioned that the double‑digit growth in Q3, which includes both previously deferred deals and normal purchases, should not be seen as sustainable, and growth may slow in Q4.

Other software businesses showed mixed results: Red Hat hybrid‑cloud revenue grew 11%, data‑related revenue rose 20% on a constant‑currency basis, while automation revenue fell 3%. IBM’s total Q3 revenue was $17.103 billion, up 4.7% year‑over‑year; adjusted diluted earnings per share were $2.95, up 11% year‑over‑year. Consulting revenue was roughly flat, infrastructure revenue grew 4%, but neither matched the pace of software growth.

Before the earnings release, analysts were watching whether the delayed software deals would convert to revenue in Q3 and Q4 to determine if the prior weakness was due to postponed purchasing schedules or a genuine demand decline. Morgan Stanley believes that the completion of deferred deals and cost savings support short‑term performance, but after Q3 IBM will still face a higher comparative base and intensified competition.

IBM maintains its full‑year constant‑currency revenue growth forecast of 4%‑5% and raised its free‑cash‑flow outlook, expecting an increase of more than $1 billion versus 2025. By the company’s definition, Q3 free cash flow was $3.027 billion, up from $2.373 billion a year ago; the first three quarters combined total $7.787 billion.

items.title: AI晶片泡沫論中的財報變數 記憶體供需成關鍵
items.title_en: Financial Report Variable in the AI Chip Bubble Debate: Memory Supply and Demand Are Key
paras: 《Benzinga》報導，想像一家滑雪度假村，過去三個冬季每年都客滿，連本季也已經訂滿。然而，一份長期天氣預報卻預測，三個冬季後將迎來暖冬，結果度假村股價應聲大跌。晶片股正經歷類似情況。
作為晶片股主要指標的費城半導體指數，在截至10月14日的六個交易日下跌約10%，記憶體製造商的跌幅更大。當天公布的通膨數據高於預期，再度引發利率可能走高的討論，加劇跌勢。跌勢隨後持續，截至10月20日收盤，VanEck半導體ETF(SMH-US)較10月5日高點下跌14%。
晶片股支撐市場走了三年
過去三年，晶片股一直是推動市場上漲的重要力量。SMH在這段期間的價格幾乎翻了四倍，年化報酬率達57%。iShares半導體ETF(SOXX-US)價格也已超過三倍。
這波漲勢主要由兩類公司帶動：一是輝達(NVDA-US)，其晶片為AI模型提供運算能力；另一類則是記憶體製造商美光科技(MU-US)與SK海力士(SK Hynix)(SKHY-US)。這些公司合計占SMH的29%、SOXX的18%。
三年來，投資人一直質疑這波漲勢還能持續多久。迄今為止，獲利成長仍為股價上漲提供了支撐。
獲利成長速度超越股價
過去12個月，SMH報酬率為58%，其成分股公司的獲利則成長104%。SOXX報酬率為71%，其持股公司的獲利增加106%。
這正是為什麼即使股價上漲，這些ETF的估值反而下降：SMH的過去12個月本益比（P/E）從39倍降至30倍。同一期間，標普500指數成分股的獲利則成長約35%。
記憶體率先轉弱
這波拋售對記憶體股的衝擊最為嚴重。在截至10月15日的五個交易日內，SK海力士股價下跌26%，三星電子下跌22%，美光則下跌約11%。
兩項憂慮同時浮現。中國主要記憶體製造商長鑫存儲（CXMT）公布了一種密度更高的晶片設計，計畫在年底前將其導入伺服器市場，令人擔心該公司可能從三星、SK海力士與美光手中搶走市占率。接著，南韓《每日經濟新聞》一篇專欄文章引述業界專家警告，到2029年新增產能可能導致供給過剩，並呼籲南韓尋找下一個成長引擎。馬斯克也在X上發文稱，「中國將在2028年生產大量RAM。」
然而，從產業內部來看，記憶體短缺似乎仍將持續。Quilter Cheviot與Rosenblatt Securities的分析師不認為，CXMT能在短期內大規模生產這種新設計，並因此改變供需平衡。
美光執行長Sanjay Mehrotra於9月30日表示：「我們認為，2027年與2028年的需求都將超過供給。」根據巴克萊數據，截至10月的三個月內，DRAM合約價格上漲約五分之一。
記憶體產業向來具有繁榮與衰退交替的特性，而投資人如今提前為未來幾年的衰退定價。SMH成分股的過去12個月本益比，已從6月的約32倍降至7.7倍。
以美光對本季的財測為依據，其股價目前的本益比約為6倍，毛利率則達87%，高於一年前的46%。目前的股價反映出市場認為，這些獲利終將衰退。
包括輝達在內的AI晶片設計公司，估值也已下降。由於獲利成長速度超過股價漲幅，這些公司的過去12個月本益比已從一年前的62倍降至36倍。
這是泡沫嗎？
在泡沫市場中，股價漲幅會超越獲利成長。但過去一年，晶片股的情況恰恰相反。
不過，與自身歷史相比，晶片股的估值仍然偏高。自2017年以來，SMH目前的過去12個月本益比高於其每月歷史讀數的61%；SOXX則高於67%。兩者的估值都遠低於6月的高峰，當時SMH的本益比曾達49倍。
這些公司的自身展望仍然指向成長。台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)於10月15日公布財報，並預估第四季營收將達523億至543億美元，高於第三季的467億美元。
一天前，ASML執行長Christophe Fouquet表示，客戶正在上調需求預測，「主要是受到他們對AI相關投資規模與持續時間的看法所帶動」。
瑞銀財富管理部門則將上週跌勢形容為市場對預期進行重新校準，並認為AI投資的成長故事仍然成立。
真正可能讓市場演變成泡沫的，是獲利不再如期實現。景氣循環高峰期的獲利最容易消失，而記憶體股僅有個位數的本益比，顯示投資人已經對其中一部分獲利能否持續抱持懷疑。
當這種情況發生時，晶片基金往往會大幅下跌：截至2022年10月止的一年內，SMH與SOXX都下跌了三分之一。
目前來看，這波拋售似乎反映出投資人正在下調對景氣循環後段的預期，但企業獲利仍在成長。接下來公布的財報將是關鍵考驗。如果財報表現持續符合財測，現在的股價就比6月高峰時更有基本面支撐；如果記憶體產業如悲觀派擔心的那樣提早反轉，那麼帶動這波漲勢的公司，也可能成為領跌者。
paras_en: Benzinga reported that imagine a ski resort that has been fully booked for the past three winters and is already booked for the current season. However, a long‑range weather forecast predicts a warm winter after those three seasons, and the resort’s stock price plunged in response. Chip stocks are experiencing a similar situation.

The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index, a key gauge for chip stocks, fell about 10% over six trading days ending October 14, with memory manufacturers dropping even more. Inflation data released that day came in higher than expected, reigniting talks of rising interest rates and deepening the sell‑off. The decline continued, and by the close on October 20 the VanEck Semiconductor ETF (SMH‑US) was down 14% from its October 5 peak.
Chip stocks have supported the market for three years

Over the past three years chip stocks have been a major driver of market gains. SMH’s price nearly quadrupled during that period, delivering an annualized return of 57%. The iShares Semiconductor ETF (SOXX‑US) also more than tripled in price.

The rally has been led by two types of companies: Nvidia (NVDA‑US), whose chips provide compute power for AI models, and memory makers Micron Technology (MU‑US) and SK Hynix (SKHY‑US). Together these firms account for 29% of SMH and 18% of SOXX.
For three years investors have questioned how long the rally can last. So far earnings growth has continued to underpin the price gains.
Earnings growth outpaces price
Over the past 12 months SMH returned 58% while its constituent companies’ earnings grew 104%. SOXX returned 71% and the earnings of its holdings rose 106%.

That is why, even as prices have risen, the valuations of these ETFs have fallen: SMH’s 12‑month price‑to‑earnings ratio dropped from 39× to 30×. Over the same period S&P 500 constituents saw earnings grow about 35%.
Memory stocks turn weak first
The sell‑off has hit memory stocks hardest. In the five trading days through October 15 SK Hynix fell 26%, Samsung Electronics 22% and Micron about 11%.

Two concerns emerged simultaneously. Chinese memory maker CXMT announced a higher‑density chip design it plans to introduce to the server market by year‑end, raising fears it could steal market share from Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron. Then a column in South Korea’s Daily Economic newspaper, citing industry experts, warned that new capacity coming online by 2029 could create oversupply and urged Korea to find its next growth engine. Elon Musk also tweeted that “China will produce massive amounts of RAM in 2028.”

However, from an industry perspective memory shortages appear likely to persist. Analysts at Quilter Cheviot and Rosenblatt Securities do not believe CXMT can mass‑produce the new design in the short term, so the supply‑demand balance is unlikely to shift quickly.

Micron CEO Sanjay Mehrotra said on September 30, “We expect demand in 2027 and 2028 to exceed supply.” Barclays data show DRAM contract prices have risen roughly one‑fifth over the three months ending in October.
The memory sector has long alternated between booms and busts, and investors are now pricing in a downturn several years out. SMH constituents’ 12‑month P/E has fallen from about 32× in June to 7.7×.

Based on Micron’s guidance for the current quarter, its stock now trades at roughly a 6× P/E, with a gross margin of 87%, up from 46% a year ago. The current price reflects the market’s view that these profits will eventually wane.
AI chip designers, including Nvidia, have also seen valuations fall. Because earnings growth has outpaced price appreciation, their 12‑month P/E has dropped from 62× a year ago to 36×.
Is this a bubble?
In a bubble market stock price gains outstrip earnings growth. Over the past year, chip stocks have shown the opposite.

Nevertheless, compared with their own history, chip stocks remain richly valued. Since 2017, SMH’s current 12‑month P/E is higher than 61% of its monthly historical readings; SOXX’s is higher than 67%. Both valuations are well below the June peak, when SMH’s P/E reached 49×.

The outlook for these companies still points to growth. Taiwan Semiconductor (2330‑TW) (TSM‑US) reported earnings on October 15 and forecast Q4 revenue of $52.3‑$54.3 billion, above Q3’s $46.7 billion.
A day earlier, ASML CEO Christophe Fouquet said customers are raising demand forecasts, “driven mainly by their views on the scale and duration of AI‑related investments.”
UBS Wealth Management described last week’s decline as a market recalibration of expectations and said the growth story for AI investment remains intact.

What could truly turn the market into a bubble is earnings failing to materialize as expected. Profits tend to disappear first at the peak of the economic cycle, and memory stocks now have single‑digit P/E multiples, indicating investors doubt the sustainability of a portion of those earnings.
When that happens, chip funds often tumble sharply: over the year ending October 2022, both SMH and SOXX fell about one‑third.

At present the sell‑off appears to reflect investors trimming expectations for the later part of the cycle, while corporate earnings are still growing. Upcoming earnings reports will be the decisive test. If results continue to meet guidance, today’s prices have more fundamental support than the June peak; if the memory sector reverses earlier than optimistic forecasts, the companies that have driven the rally could become the laggards.
